purpose: Author-synthetic DEV falsification: does training original native HybridPilot as a factual-confirmation-conditioned residual over exact P86/W256 produce novel action-consequence prediction gain without leakage?

data.generator: P87 portable P86-style dyadic 16D action->16D effect; 48 observed action-consequence pairs, novel final query withheld; 50% hidden switch after event24; no query effect in history
prohibit: cross-platform source drift or source hash retrofit

arms.experimental: AnchoredHybridPilot with original intact 5,297-param HybridPilot and explicit W256 confirmed causal memory; only residual path trainable; initial residual_scale=0; all factual history confirmed; predict final query withheld outcome
comparator: P86 CAL-frozen eta=1 decay=0.99 W256 with 256 float32 predictive values
same AnchoredHybridPilot with zero residual: exact baseline parity
P78 original eta=0.5 and decay=1 (additional control)
negatives: unconfirmed effect replacement, including NaN, must not change prediction
query outcome not observed or written
cold restored W256 fast state must be bitwise identical
residual model must not read oracle world-change labels

training.checkpoint_selection: CAL only; exact same FIT actions/effects/indices across experimental arms; record initial/final model hashes

metrics: final 16D effect MSE combined, stable and changed
score every checkpoint; no post-CAL tuning
cold restore bitwise factual state and query read-only
full 49-step history+query end-to-end CPU latency including factual updates and native Hybrid residual
trainable parameter count and persistent float state disclosed separately

acceptance.interpretation: DEV-only admission at best; not scientific pass or deployable model

stop_criteria: any source overlap or hash drift
no gain over W256 in either regime after frozen schedule
any risk to original model or owner science first-use

qualification.G4: mandatory exact candidate Windows+Linux complete CPU regression
qualification.scientific: separate independent real-source first-use, fully trained matched controls and external qualification required before SCIENTIFIC_PASS
